Task: Improve the understandability of the test `Md5CryptTest_testMd5CryptExplicitCallWithThreadLocalRandom.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/commons-codec/manual/testcases/Md5CryptTest/Md5CryptTest_testMd5CryptExplicitCallWithThreadLocalRandom.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The CUT zeroes the `keyBytes` array (`Arrays.fill(keyBytes, (byte) 0)`), so sharing one array between calls would change behavior. I need fresh bytes per call.Compiles successfully (`COMPILE_OK`). The refactored test keeps identical behavior—fresh `"secret".getBytes()` arrays per call (the CUT zeroes the key array), the same `md5Crypt` calls and regex assertion—while adding a descriptive class Javadoc, named constants for the password and the format pattern, explanatory comments, and assertion messages.
